MARKET.SalesConcessionDescription: 33% of the above sales sold with concessions from 0% to 3%. 21% of the sales sold for cash. The seller concession trend is suggested to be stable. Seller concessions are adjusted to approximate the market's reaction to the concessions.
MARKET.NeighborhoodMarketabilityFactorsDescript: Out of the 89 sales and 26 listings reported above, 7% of the sales were reo foreclosure sales or short sales subject to bank approval and 23% of the listing inventory are bank controlled listings. The subject's market area is slightly influenced by distressed sales yet value is not driven by them. The comparables provided are considered to be the best indicators of current market value.
MARKET.DataSourceDescription: The above inventory analysis has been derived from the multiple listing service. Tax records and mls were analyzed to report foreclosure trends.
MARKET.MarketTrendsReconciliationComment: The above analysis includes closed and pending sales, expired and withdrawn listings and listing which were temporarily off the market to indicate the amount of listings and/or sales per period. Each data period has been analyzed to determine if the trend is declining, stable, or increasing. The conclusion reached is based on analyzing the last 12 months, however most weight was given to the most recent 3 month period as it suggests the most recent market trends. It appears the subjects market area is stable with sale prices slightly increasing and listing prices showing a decline. Months of housing supply is at 3.5 months and increasing which suggests supply to be in balance with demand. Median DOM is under 90 days and stable from the previous columns, marketing time is reported to be under 3 months.

Search Parameters: Actual Close Date: 12 months Back Property Type: Single Family Residential Status: ER, EA, C, P, S Living Area: between 1700sf and 2100sf Bldg Desc: 2 story; tri-level Lot sqft: is less than 5000 Built between: 1997 and 2012 and is not guard gated or located in a golf course community Market Area: Map search of neighborhood boundaries stated on page 1 This search derived the 86 closed sales and 26 listings reported within the 1004 mc form.

SALES_COMPARISON._CurrentSalesAgreementAnalysisComment:
The 04/30/2014 transfer of the subject was a distressed short sale that was on the market for over 278 days. Since this transfer the subject appears to have been updated with wood plantation shutters, new interior paint, new baseboards and laminate wood flooring throughout. This previous transfer has little relevance to current market value.
***County records reports the living area to be 1891 square feet. However after measurements the actual livable area is 1894. The 06/24/2015 transfer of comp #4 was a reo foreclosure sale and has no relevance to current market value.
SALES_COMPARISON._Comment:
All 5 selected comparable sales and 2 listings are in the subjects' competitive market area and utilized within this report as they are considered to be the most appropriate for comparison to the subject property as of the effective date of this assignment. All positive and negative adjustments of the comparable sales were required in areas of dissimilarity to produce the best indicated value of the subject. Comparable sales #1 and #4 are the most recent model match sales located within the subject’s subdivision. Comp #1 is however inferior in condition and upgrades having little to no updates with standard carpeting and cabinetry. Comp #4 is superior in concessions; inferior in being adjacent to the neighborhood through street of Huntington Cove. Comparable sales #2 and #5 are additional sales located within the subject’s subdivision that are slightly superior in living area with comp #2 also superior in lot size and comp #5 superior in concessions, and covered patio/balcony. Comp #3 is the most recent similar sale located within the closest competitive subdivision that has homes similar in size, style, age, and quality. This sale is superior in concessions and covered patio. Most weight is given to comps #1, #2, and #3. Comps #4 and #5 are slightly dated and given least weight. The opinion of value falls within the original and adjusted sale prices of the comparable sales provided. Condition: Local mls only has five categories for condition; excellent (recently refurbished or improved), very good (has had some updates and minimal wear and tear) good (average and typical), fair (in need of minor repairs), and poor (in need of extensive repairs with limited financing available). After further analysis of the comparables comments, photo's, virtual tours, and inspection of comparables from street the appraiser has given, in his opinion, an accurate condition to the comparables and subject property based on the c1-c6 condition rating. The condition given to the subject is considered to be a typical home within the subject’s subdivision. Some of the comparables may have had remodeling work completed or may have been neglected or vandalize since their sale. The condition of the comparable is based on its condition at the time of sale.
Room and Bedroom count: Some of the comparables provided are inferior or superior to the subject in bedroom count or total room count. This is typical as some properties have dens, lofts, larger living areas, larger bedrooms, or two separate living areas such as family rooms or recreation rooms. The appraisers research derived no justifiable value difference for these separate room or bedroom differences therefore it is the opinion of the appraiser that room and bedroom count is a matter of personal preferences. Adjustments have been given for total living area.
Predominate Value: The value conclusion is above the predominate value stated on page 1. This was unavoidable due to the large number of sales within the market area inferior to the subject in size and amenities. There are homes within the search that are far superior to the subject in living area and recent sales that have sales prices far above the opinion of value therefore the subject is considered not to be an over improvement for the market.
Age Differences: Effective age is directly related to condition. The market reaction to differences in actual age and/or effective age is not supported or deemed necessary as all comparables provided are considered to have an actual and/or an effective age within 10 years of the subject. The appraiser has given adjustments within condition for their differences.
